summary.content:
Today's selection covers 57 articles from 6 trusted sources, including 38 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Why trust is a big question at the Elon Musk-OpenAI trial
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Hackers earn $1,298,250 for 47 zero-days at Pwn2Own Berlin 2026
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, BBC Technology, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 17 articles published in the last 24 hours
